title: Sports equipment drive at Harvard-Westlake
description: Bring cleats, balls, pads, helmets, gloves, jerseys, and racquets. Used is fine if it's clean and intact. Everything collected is donated at LA Promise Fund's Pavo Palooza on November 21.

title: Pavo Palooza
description: Where everything collected in the Harvard-Westlake drive gets donated.
